title: Plan artifact with wait steps and waves (proposed extension of spec/plan.schema.json)
description: The plan artifact as proposals 01–03 extend it: `assume[].state` and the symbolic vocabulary gain `ready`; `steps[]` admits a second form, the wait step; an optional `waves` groups step indices that may run concurrently. Everything else is spec/plan.schema.json unchanged; a plan without wait steps or waves is exactly a v0.1 plan. Hash: `plan_` over the JCS form with `hash` removed, unsigned, as today.

label.description: Advisory: `<serving id>/<step id>`; not read by the checker.

oneOf.description: An operation step, exactly as spec/plan.schema.json. Proposal 02 adds one argument form for values known only at kitchen time: the variant `Later` whose payload names `<step label>.<output>`, or `LaterJson` whose payload is a JSON body template with `{{<step label>.<output>}}` and `{{secret}}` placeholders and literal top-level fields (which `body-field` keys ground from); the checker treats a `Later` argument as opaque and grounds keys only from literal parts.

A wait step (proposal 03): symbolically `requires (resource, exists)` and `ensures (resource, until)`; at run time a paced poll of `probe` until `ready_when` (for `ready`) or a not-found answer (for `absent`), failing as wait-timeout after `limit_seconds`.

waves.description: Proposal 02: indices into `steps`, grouped; steps in one wave have no dependency between them and may run concurrently. `steps` is the waves flattened in order.
